title: Buyer Lead Scoring & Routing

blueprintSignals.name: Viewing depth
blueprintSignals.definition: number of distinct listings viewed and the share viewed more than once in 7 days
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Bots inflate views, so filter them before computing

blueprintSignals.name: Finance readiness
blueprintSignals.definition: pre-approval flag and stated budget relative to the viewed prices
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Self-reported readiness is unreliable, so prefer a verified flag

blueprintSignals.name: Agent response time
blueprintSignals.definition: median minutes from enquiry to first contact over the last 30 days
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Agents can game it by sending empty acknowledgements

blueprintSignals.name: Area expertise
blueprintSignals.definition: the agent's closed sales in the lead's search area over 24 months
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Sparse for new agents, so shrink towards the team average

engineFeatures.meaning: count and sum of the entity's events in the last minute, hour and day, closed strictly before the decision time
distinct entities seen on the same group in the last 24 hours

share of confirmed positives at the counterparty, using only labels that had arrived by decision time
value compared with the entity's own normal

label: For "Buyer Lead Scoring & Routing": Score portal enquiries by likelihood to transact and route them to the agent best placed to convert them quickly. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Outcomes are observed only for leads that were contacted, so the model cannot learn from the rest.
